tools.name: checker_start
tools.description: The first question of the Which provenance text speaks to your data? decision guide.

tools.name: checker_answer
tools.description: Given a question id and the chosen option (its `choice` index), return the next question or the final verdict.

tools.name: checker_tree
tools.description: Every question, option and verdict of the Which provenance text speaks to your data? guide, for reasoning end to end.

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on AI Data Provenance: it starts an enquiry with AI Data Provenance, whose team reads it and replies directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and h

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the AI Data Provenance enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key. With form, the questions of that guide's own form.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to AI Data Provenance: NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show the person the summary and the consent line.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
